body.msg: IMPORTANT: Found multiple concurrent agent processes (several implementer, researcher, reviewer instances) all running against the SAME dependency_check working directory (not isolated worktrees) at the same time (confirmed via ps aux: PIDs 62213/62214/66309/66315 implementer, 63880/63881/69349/69351 researcher, 66797/66798/67603/67613 reviewer, 68628/68630 tester, all pointing at /Users/bedil_karimov/Documents/dependency_check or depfix-agents). Concretely hit a race: I ran git checkout -b fix/migrate-agent-changes, and between that and my git commit, another process switched the shared checkout to a different branch (fix/t18-multi-major-removals), so my commit landed on the wrong branch. I recovered it (moved the commit to the right branch, restored the other branch to its original commit, nothing was lost), but this is a real hazard — concurrent agents sharing one working directory for git checkout/commit can corrupt each others state. dependency_check has no git.lock equivalent to the one depfix-agents uses for commits. Recommend: either serialize git-mutating operations in dependency_check behind a flock (like depfix-agents does), or give each concurrent agent its own worktree/clone.
